title: Conflicted Records: Typed Adversarial Contracts for Auditable LLM Output Quality Enforcement

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the stereotyped-option pick rate on ambiguous-arm multiple-choice items from the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) Age category, where a constraint-satisfying record should select the neutral answer rather than a stereotyped demographic.

Measuring the stereotyped-option pick rate on multiple-choice items from the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) Disability category to evaluate the within-domain transfer capabilities of the proposed adversarial framework.
